addShape.doc: function(minX:number, minY:number, minZ:number, maxX:number, maxY:number, maxZ:number, texture:string[, state:boolean=false][,tint:number]) -- Adds a shape to the printers configuration, optionally specifying whether it is for the off or on state.

commit.doc: function([count:number]):boolean -- Commit and begin printing the current configuration.

getLabel.doc: function():string -- Get the current label for the block being printed.

getLightLevel.doc: function():number -- Get which light level the printed block should have.

getMaxShapeCount.doc: function():number -- Get the maximum allowed number of shapes.

getShapeCount.doc: function():number -- Get the number of shapes in the current configuration.

getTooltip.doc: function():string -- Get the current tooltip for the block being printed.

isButtonMode.doc: function():boolean -- Get whether the printed block should automatically return to its off state.

isCollidable.doc: function():boolean, boolean -- Get whether the printed block should be collidable or not.

isRedstoneEmitter.doc: function():boolean, number -- Get whether the printed block should emit redstone when in its active state.

reset.doc: function() -- Resets the configuration of the printer and stop printing (current job will finish).

setButtonMode.doc: function(value:boolean) -- Set whether the printed block should automatically return to its off state.

setCollidable.doc: function(collideOff:boolean, collideOn:boolean) -- Set whether the printed block should be collidable or not.

setLabel.doc: function(value:string) -- Set a label for the block being printed.

setLightLevel.doc: function(value:number) -- Set what light level the printed block should have.

setRedstoneEmitter.doc: function(value:boolean or number) -- Set whether the printed block should emit redstone when in its active state.

setTooltip.doc: function(value:string) -- Set a tooltip for the block being printed.

status.doc: function(): string, number or boolean -- The current state of the printer, `busy' or `idle', followed by the progress or model validity, respectively.

getBundledInput.doc: function([side:number[, color:number]]):number or table -- Fewer params returns set of inputs

getBundledOutput.doc: function([side:number[, color:number]]):number or table -- Fewer params returns set of outputs

getComparatorInput.doc: function(side:number):number -- Get the comparator input on the specified side.

getInput.doc: function([side:number]):number or table -- Get the redstone input (all sides, or optionally on the specified side)

getOutput.doc: function([side:number]):number or table -- Get the redstone output (all sides, or optionally on the specified side)

getWakeThreshold.doc: function():number -- Get the current wake-up threshold.

getWirelessFrequency.doc: function():number -- Get the currently set wireless redstone frequency.

getWirelessInput.doc: function():number -- Get the wireless redstone input.

getWirelessOutput.doc: function():boolean -- Get the wireless redstone output.

setBundledOutput.doc: function([side:number[, color:number,]] value:number or table):number or table --  Fewer params to assign set of outputs. Returns previous values

setOutput.doc: function([side:number, ]value:number or table):number or table --  Set the redstone output (all sides, or optionally on the specified side). Returns previous values

setWirelessFrequency.doc: function(frequency:number):number -- Set the wireless redstone frequency to use.

setWirelessOutput.doc: function(value:boolean):boolean -- Set the wireless redstone output.

compare.doc: function(side:number[, fuzzy:boolean=false]):boolean -- Compare the block on the specified side with the one in the selected slot. Returns true if equal.

compareFluid.doc: function(side:number [, tank:number]):boolean -- Compare the fluid in the selected tank with the fluid in the specified tank on the specified side. Returns true if equal.

compareFluidTo.doc: function(index:number):boolean -- Compares the fluids in the selected and the specified tank. Returns true if equal.

compareTo.doc: function(otherSlot:number[, checkNBT:boolean=false]):boolean -- Compare the contents of the selected slot to the contents of the specified slot.

count.doc: function([slot:number]):number -- Get the number of items in the specified slot, otherwise in the selected slot.

detect.doc: function(side:number):boolean, string -- Checks the contents of the block on the specified sides and returns the findings.

drain.doc: function(side:boolean[, amount:number=1000]):boolean, number or string -- Drains the specified amount of fluid from the specified side. Returns the amount drained, or an error message.

drop.doc: function(side:number[, count:number=64]):boolean -- Drops items from the selected slot towards the specified side.

durability.doc: function():number -- Get the durability of the currently equipped tool.

fill.doc: function(side:number[, amount:number=1000]):boolean, number of string -- Eject the specified amount of fluid to the specified side. Returns the amount ejected or an error message.

getLightColor.doc: function():number -- Get the current color of the activity light as an integer encoded RGB value (0xRRGGBB).

inventorySize.doc: function():number -- The size of this device's internal inventory.

isRunning.doc: function():boolean -- Returns whether the robot is running.

move.doc: function(direction:number):boolean -- Move in the specified direction.

name.doc: function():string -- Get the name of the agent.

place.doc: function(side:number[, face:number=side[, sneaky:boolean=false]]):boolean -- Place a block towards the specified side. The `face' allows a more precise click calibration, and is relative to the targeted blockspace.

select.doc: function([slot:number]):number -- Get the currently selected slot; set the selected slot if specified.

selectTank.doc: function([index:number]):number -- Select a tank and/or get the number of the currently selected tank.

setLightColor.doc: function(value:number):number -- Set the color of the activity light to the specified integer encoded RGB value (0xRRGGBB).

setName.doc: function(name: string):string -- Sets a new name and returns the old name. Robot must not be running

space.doc: function([slot:number]):number -- Get the remaining space in the specified slot, otherwise in the selected slot.

start.doc: function():boolean -- Starts the robot. Returns true if the state changed.

stop.doc: function():boolean -- Stops the robot. Returns true if the state changed.

suck.doc: function(side:number[, count:number=64]):boolean -- Suck up items from the specified side.

swing.doc: function(side:number[, face:number=side[, sneaky:boolean=false]]):boolean, string -- Perform a 'left click' towards the specified side. The `face' allows a more precise click calibration, and is relative to the targeted blockspace.

tankCount.doc: function():number -- The number of tanks installed in the device.

tankLevel.doc: function([index:number]):number -- Get the fluid amount in the specified or selected tank.

tankSpace.doc: function([index:number]):number -- Get the remaining fluid capacity in the specified or selected tank.

transferFluidTo.doc: function(index:number[, count:number=1000]):boolean -- Move the specified amount of fluid from the selected tank into the specified tank.

transferTo.doc: function(toSlot:number[, amount:number]):boolean -- Move up to the specified amount of items from the selected slot into the specified slot.

turn.doc: function(clockwise:boolean):boolean -- Rotate in the specified direction.

use.doc: function(side:number[, face:number=side[, sneaky:boolean=false[, duration:number=0]]]):boolean, string -- Perform a 'right click' towards the specified side. The `face' allows a more precise click calibration, and is relative to the targeted blockspace.

getAspectRatio.doc: function():number, number -- The aspect ratio of the screen. For multi-block screens this is the number of blocks, horizontal and vertical.

getKeyboards.doc: function():table -- The list of keyboards attached to the screen.

isOn.doc: function():boolean -- Returns whether the screen is currently on.

isPrecise.doc: function():boolean -- Returns whether the screen is in high precision mode (sub-pixel mouse event positions).

isTouchModeInverted.doc: function():boolean -- Whether touch mode is inverted (sneak-activate opens GUI, instead of normal activate).

setPrecise.doc: function(enabled:boolean):boolean -- Set whether to use high precision mode (sub-pixel mouse event positions).

setTouchModeInverted.doc: function(value:boolean):boolean -- Sets whether to invert touch mode (sneak-activate opens GUI, instead of normal activate).

turnOff.doc: function():boolean -- Turns off the screen. Returns true if it was on.

turnOn.doc: function():boolean -- Turns the screen on. Returns true if it was off.

getValue.doc: function(side:number):string -- Get the text on the sign on the specified side of the adapter.

setValue.doc: function(side:number, value:string):string -- Set the text on the sign on the specified side of the adapter.

getPitch.doc: function():number -- Gets the pitch of the player holding the tablet.

getYaw.doc: function():number -- Gets the yaw of the player holding the tablet.

drain.doc: function([amount:number]):boolean -- Transfers fluid from a tank in the selected inventory slot to the selected tank.

fill.doc: function([amount:number]):boolean -- Transfers fluid from the selected tank to a tank in the selected inventory slot.

getFluidInInternalTank.doc: function([tank:number]):table -- Get a description of the fluid in the tank in the specified slot or the selected slot.

getFluidInTank.doc: function(side:number [, tank:number]):table -- Get a description of the fluid in the the tank on the specified side.

getFluidInTankInSlot.doc: function([slot:number]):table -- Get a description of the fluid in the tank item in the specified slot or the selected slot.

getTankCapacity.doc: function(side:number [, tank:number]):number -- Get the capacity of the tank on the specified side.

getTankCapacityInSlot.doc: function([slot:number]):number -- Get the capacity of the tank item in the specified slot of the robot or the selected slot.

getTankLevel.doc: function(side:number [, tank:number]):number -- Get the amount of fluid in the tank on the specified side.

getTankLevelInSlot.doc: function([slot:number]):number -- Get the amount of fluid in the tank item in the specified slot or the selected slot.

suck.doc: function():boolean -- Tries to pick up a random item in the robots' vicinity.

getTrades.doc: function():table -- Returns a table of trades in range as userdata objects.

areStacksEquivalent.doc: function(side:number, slotA:number, slotB:number):boolean -- Get whether the items in the two specified slots of the inventory on the specified side of the device are equivalent (have shared OreDictionary IDs).

compareStackToDatabase.doc: function(side:number, slot:number, dbAddress:string, dbSlot:number[, checkNBT:boolean=false]):boolean -- Compare an item in the specified slot in the inventory on the specified side with one in the database with the specified address.

compareStacks.doc: function(side:number, slotA:number, slotB:number[, checkNBT:boolean=false]):boolean -- Get whether the items in the two specified slots of the inventory on the specified side of the device are of the same type.

getAllStacks.doc: function(side:number):userdata -- Get a description of all stacks in the inventory on the specified side of the device.

getFluidInTank.doc: function(side:number [, tank:number]):table -- Get a description of the fluid in the the tank on the specified side.

getInventoryName.doc: function(side:number):string -- Get the the name of the inventory on the specified side of the device.

getInventorySize.doc: function(side:number):number -- Get the number of slots in the inventory on the specified side of the device.

getSlotMaxStackSize.doc: function(side:number, slot:number):number -- Get the maximum number of items in the specified slot of the inventory on the specified side of the device.

getSlotStackSize.doc: function(side:number, slot:number):number -- Get number of items in the specified slot of the inventory on the specified side of the device.

getStackInSlot.doc: function(side:number, slot:number):table -- Get a description of the stack in the inventory on the specified side of the device.

getTankCapacity.doc: function(side:number [, tank:number]):number -- Get the capacity of the tank on the specified side.

getTankLevel.doc: function(side:number [, tank:number]):number -- Get the amount of fluid in the tank on the specified side.

store.doc: function(side:number, slot:number, dbAddress:string, dbSlot:number):boolean -- Store an item stack description in the specified slot of the database with the specified address.

transferFluid.doc: function(sourceSide:number, sinkSide:number[, count:number]):number -- Transfer some items between two inventories.

transferItem.doc: function(sourceSide:number, sinkSide:number[, count:number[, sourceSlot:number[, sinkSlot:number]]]):boolean -- Transfer some items between two inventories.

getChannel.doc: function():string -- Gets this link card's shared channel address

getWakeMessage.doc: function():string, boolean -- Get the current wake-up message.

maxPacketSize.doc: function():number -- Gets the maximum packet size (config setting).

send.doc: function(data...) -- Sends the specified data to the card this one is linked to.

setWakeMessage.doc: function(message:string[, fuzzy:boolean]):string -- Set the wake-up message and whether to ignore additional data/parameters.

getLabel.doc: function(): string -- Get the current label of this waypoint.

setLabel.doc: function(value:string) -- Set the label for this waypoint.
